title: Interactive product demos that live in your repo
subtitle: Record a real product flow, turn it into a click-through walkthrough, and publish it as a link or embed.

widgets.title: Interactive product demos that live in your repo
widgets.description: Record a real product flow, turn it into a click-through walkthrough, and keep the plain files in your repo. Your agent can maintain them as the product changes.

image.alt: A finished interactive demo mid-play: a product's funnel screen with a hotspot on the funnel and the hotspot's card

steps.label: Your agent does it

background.alt: A Claude Code session at work: one prompt, then the agent loads the skill, runs capture start, clicks through the app, runs capture stop, writes the copy and validates it

steps.script: Ask your agent for a demo. It loads the skill, records your app with the CLI, then writes the copy. All of it lands as plain files in your repo.

captions.text: Ask your agent for a demo.
It loads the skill, records your app with the CLI, then writes the copy.
All of it lands as plain files in your repo.

annotations.text: One prompt. This is a real Claude Code session: it read the skill, recorded six clicks and wrote the copy itself.

steps.label: Or record it yourself

background.alt: The Interactive Demo Capture extension recording a product in Chrome: Start Recording, three clicks, and the popup counting three steps

steps.script: Or record it yourself. The Chrome extension turns every click in your own browser into a step.

captions.text: The Chrome extension turns every click in your own browser into a step.

annotations.text: Or record it yourself, in your own browser. The **Interactive Demo Capture** extension turns every click into a step.

steps.label: Polish in the editor

background.alt: The local editor open on the captured demo, a hotspot selected and its text being edited in the side panel

steps.script: Polish it with your agent. Or, if you prefer a UI, the editor edits the same files.

captions.text: Or, if you prefer a UI, the editor edits the same files.

annotations.text: Polish it with your agent: it edits the same `demo.config.json`. Prefer a UI? The editor does it too.

steps.label: Ship it anywhere

background.alt: Scrolling a marketing page down to the demo embedded in it

steps.script: Publish it for a link, or build a folder for any static host. Either way, it embeds inline or as a pop-up.

captions.text: Publish it for a link, or build a folder for any static host.
Either way, it embeds inline or as a pop-up.

annotations.text: The agent's demo, live on a marketing page. `publish` prints a link; `build` writes a folder you host yourself.
